Name: Alecktoo's Emoji Bobbers
Author: kirinkode
Description:
[font=Courier New][u][b][color=#f4f4f4]About[/color][/b][/u]
Pretty simple visual mod that turns some of the two toned bobbers into a selection of the in-game chat emojis! Please note this does replace the entire tile sheet and there are no config options. I may make adjustments in the future but for now i think its fiiiiiine.

[b][u]How Do I Unlock More Bobbers?[/u][/b]
They're unlocked by catching 2 [u]new[/u] fish each. You'll always get the first bobber as your default but to unlock the second one you'll need to catch 2 new fish and so on.
